exposure: use of a novel birth simulator for IFH training
outcome: Success rate of fetal head delivery
Time taken to deliver fetal head
finding: This novel birth trainer realistically simulates IFH at cesarean section and allows rehearsal of all disimpaction techniques.
mod_finding: The simulator was considered very useful for training and distinguishes between novice and expert obstetricians in terms of success rate and time taken to deliver the fetal head during simulated IFH at cesarean section.
